mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the sensory route was most worthwhile because it connected the closed-eyes question to muscle-length information returning to the nervous system. The described comparison of two positions helped explain what the construction contributes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the outgoing nerves to the control system was a fairly predictable intermediate step, though it made the later attachment to the arm clear.

surprise.text: The final distinction that muscle sensors contribute to sensing limb position but do not locate an unseen target sharpened my understanding of what the feedback can do.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the available parts and successive goals gave each connection a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the chapter built a clear link between outgoing commands and returning sensory information, and I am curious how other body systems will support the arm's work.
